subject: Final runway: environment access & MAP close timeline
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 9 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final runway: environment access & MAP close timeline

Thanks Samira — following up with a concise MAP snapshot so we can unlock your POC environment next week. Attached: MAP-v3 (milestones), ip-allowlist-template.csv, and a short keys instructions file. High level asks from HealthLytics to unblock staging: 

- Org admin created for Redwood service account (email redwood-service@healthlytics.com) with Viewer role on the project by EOD Tue 6/11.
- IP allowlist populated with the three /27s in the template (Neha notes these are our staging egress ranges).
- VPC peering request in the cloud console (we prefer passive-accept approach; details below).
- Procurement contact to sign the SOW addendum (we can DocuSign the form linked below).

Proposed close timeline: environment unlocked by Fri 6/14, verification run Mon 6/17, MAP complete and POC kickoff 6/18. If any of these windows don't work, propose alternatives.

Neha / Ben — can you confirm the exact ip ranges and the service account permissions we need? Samira — if you can loop procurement and IT ops on the reply that will help speed things.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-v3.pdf (milestones), ip-allowlist-template.csv, redwood-staging-keys-instructions.txt
From: Samira Ali <samira@healthlytics.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, procurement@healthlytics.com, IT Ops <itops@healthlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final runway: environment access & MAP close timeline

Thanks Avery — appreciate the concise plan and attachments. A few quick clarifications before we proceed: 

1) IP ranges: are the /27s in the template final for staging, or are they placeholders? We need the final numerical ranges to get the firewall change scheduled.
2) VPC peering: does Redwood require route exchange or only private DNS resolution? Our security team prefers minimal routing footprint.
3) Service account: procurement will only allow a service account with scoped, non-admin roles. Please confirm the least-privilege permissions (we can approve Viewer + specific API roles).

Looping procurement and IT Ops here — procurement@healthlytics.com will own the contract SOW signature; IT Ops please advise earliest window you have for firewall changes (we're targeting 6/13–6/14).

—Samira
Samira Ali
Head of Data & Integrations
HealthLytics

On Sat, Jun 9, 2028 at 09:12 AM Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com> wrote:

Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final runway: environment access & MAP close timeline

Hi Samira — quick technical answers below and confirmation of the exact ranges. Apologies for the late hour.

1) IP ranges: the CSV is a template but the three staging egress CIDRs we will use are: 35.198.96.0/27, 35.199.64.0/27, 35.200.128.0/27. Please add those to the allowlist.

2) VPC peering: Redwood prefers a simple peering with route exchange for the staging subnet only (no full route table export). We can restrict exported routes to the single staging subnet on our side; your side can accept only the specific prefixes. If your security team prefers DNS-only, we can provide an alternative using private endpoints instead — but that will add ~24–36 hours to setup.

3) Service account permissions: create redwood-service@healthlytics.com and grant the following minimal roles: Viewer + Compute Network Viewer + IAM Service Account User. That allows us to establish peering and perform health checks — nothing more.

Call proposal: 30-minute tech sync Wed 6/13 11:00–11:30 PT to walk VPC peering flow and confirm firewall timing. If that works for IT Ops, I will send a calendar invite.

Ben — can you prepare a one-page checklist we can attach to procurement to describe what the SOW amendment covers?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference

> On Mon, Jun 11, 2028 at 08:03 AM Samira Ali <samira@healthlytics.com> wrote:

Subject: Re: Final runway: environment access & MAP close timeline

Perfect — thanks all for the fast turnaround. Final agreed next steps and owners (MAP action items):

- IT Ops (HealthLytics) — add 35.198.96.0/27, 35.199.64.0/27, 35.200.128.0/27 to staging allowlist by EOD Thu 6/14. (Ticket #HL-7192)
- HealthLytics Admin — create redwood-service@healthlytics.com with Viewer + Compute Network Viewer + IAM SA User by Wed 6/13 17:00 PT.
- Procurement — sign SOW addendum via DocuSign link (see related links) and confirm completed by Thu 6/14.
- Redwood (Neha) — initiate peering request on receipt of service account and allowed prefixes; provide peering acceptance window and verify route export scoping.
- Redwood (Ben) — prepare one-page SOW checklist for procurement and attach to the DocuSign packet.

Meeting: Tech sync confirmed Wed 6/13 11:00–11:30 PT (invite sent).

If all items finish on schedule we will perform the verification run Fri 6/14 morning and aim to kick off POC on Mon 6/17. If procurement needs extra time, we can shift verification to Mon 6/17 and kickoff 6/20 — notify by EOD Thu 6/14.

Thanks again — I'll follow up after the tech sync with a brief status note.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
